text_block_list.text:
Deep breath in, deep breath out... The day 
has finally come, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Deep breath in, deep breath out... Watch 
me, I'll take 1st place this time for 
sure...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm just breathing deeeeeply so I 
don't get a nosebleed from getting too 
excited.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Today is an important race to redeem my 
honor, so I must avoid getting scratched 
due to a nosebleed...
choice_data_list: I see... Good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well then, I'm heading off...!
